name: New York Strip Steak
notes: Beef NY strip / Kansas City strip / top loin steak, bone-in or boneless. Must NOT match strip-steak sandwich kits, pork loin strips, chicken strips, jerky, frozen meals, or seasoned/marinated value-added packs.

name: T-Bone / Porterhouse Steak
notes: Beef T-bone or porterhouse steak, fresh. Must NOT match pork t-bone chops, dog treats/bones, frozen dinners, or steak sauce.

name: Filet Mignon / Beef Tenderloin Steak
notes: Beef tenderloin filet steaks or tenderloin roast portion. Must NOT match pork tenderloin (separate existing item), fish fillets, bacon-wrapped prepared entrees, or 'filet' fish products.

name: Flank Steak
notes: Fresh beef flank steak. Must NOT match marinated fajita kits, pre-cooked carne asada meals, or London broil labels (those map to round steak).

name: Skirt Steak
notes: Fresh beef skirt steak (inside or outside), plain. Must NOT match pre-marinated/seasoned fajita meat, cooked strips, or frozen meal kits.

name: Flat Iron Steak
notes: Beef flat iron (top blade) steak, fresh; regularly stocked at Aldi/Hy-Vee. Must NOT match flat-iron seasoned entrees, irons/housewares, or chuck roast.

name: Beef Brisket
notes: Fresh/raw beef brisket flat or point (whole packer at Sam's). Must NOT match corned beef brisket (separate candidate), pre-cooked/smoked BBQ brisket tubs, brisket sandwiches, or burnt-end prepared items.

name: Beef Stew Meat
notes: Raw cubed beef for stew. Must NOT match canned beef stew (Dinty Moore), frozen stew meals, stew vegetables, dog food stew, or pork stew meat.

name: Beef Short Ribs
notes: Bone-in or boneless beef short ribs / flanken style, raw. Must NOT match baby back or pork ribs (existing items), pre-cooked braised short rib entrees, or rib-flavored sauces.

name: Cube Steak
notes: Tenderized beef cube steak (minute steak), raw. Must NOT match breaded country-fried steak (frozen), pork cutlets, steak-umm sliced steaks (separate shaved-beef candidate), or bouillon cubes.

name: Beef Round Steak
notes: Top/bottom round steak or London broil, raw. Must NOT match ground round (maps to ground beef), round roasts (separate rump-roast candidate), cube steak, or eye of round labels priced as roast.

name: Beef Rump / Bottom Round Roast
notes: Bottom round, rump, or eye of round roast, raw. Must NOT match chuck roast (existing item), pot roast frozen meals, deli roast beef, or gravy/seasoning packets.

name: Sirloin Tip Roast
notes: Beef sirloin tip (round tip) roast, raw. COLLISION FLAG: existing sirloin-steak matcher includes bare 'sirloin'; that entry must exclude 'tip' and 'roast'. Must NOT match sirloin steak, ground sirloin, or pork sirloin.

name: Shaved Beef / Sandwich Steaks
notes: Thin-shaved beef for philly cheesesteaks: fresh shaved steak trays or frozen wafer sandwich steaks (Steak-umm type). Must NOT match cheesesteak frozen meals/hot pockets, deli roast beef, or beef jerky.

name: Corned Beef Brisket
notes: Raw cured corned beef brisket (point or flat, with spice packet). Must NOT match canned corned beef (separate candidate), corned beef hash, deli-sliced corned beef, or plain beef brisket.

name: Beef Liver
notes: Sliced beef liver, raw (fresh or frozen). Must NOT match liverwurst/braunschweiger (separate candidate), chicken livers (separate candidate), liver dog treats, pate, or liver-flavored pet food.

name: Beef Oxtail
notes: Raw beef oxtail pieces (stocked at Baker's/Family Fare). Must NOT match oxtail soup mix/seasoning, canned soup, or dog chews.

name: Beef Soup Bones / Shank
notes: Raw beef soup bones, shank cross-cut, or marrow bones for cooking. Must NOT match dog bones/chews, broth/stock (existing item), or bouillon.

name: Beef Tongue
notes: Whole raw beef tongue / res lengua (Hispanic meat case at Baker's/Family Fare/Walmart). Must NOT match tongue-shaped candy, pickled/canned tongue, or pet products.

name: Ground Bison
notes: Ground bison/buffalo 90%+ lean, 1-lb brick. Must NOT match bison jerky, bison burger patties in frozen meals, ground beef blends, or buffalo-style chicken products ('buffalo' sauce items).

name: Meatloaf Mix (Beef & Pork)
notes: Fresh ground beef+pork (sometimes veal) meatloaf blend tray. Must NOT match plain 80/20 ground beef (existing item), boxed meatloaf seasoning mix, breadcrumb kits, or prepared/frozen meatloaf entrees.

name: Pork Loin Roast (Whole/Half)
notes: Whole or half boneless pork center loin roast. Must NOT match pork TENDERLOIN (existing separate item), pork chops cut from loin, marinated/seasoned loin filets, or pork shoulder.

name: Pork Spare Ribs / St. Louis Ribs
notes: Raw pork spareribs or St. Louis style cut rack. Must NOT match baby back ribs (existing item), beef ribs, pre-cooked/sauced rib tubs, riblet sandwiches, or BBQ sauce.

name: Country-Style Pork Ribs
notes: Boneless or bone-in country-style pork ribs, raw. Must NOT match baby back/spare ribs, beef short ribs, country-fried steak, or pre-sauced cooked ribs.

name: Pork Steak (Shoulder Steak)
notes: Sliced pork shoulder/blade steaks (Midwest 'pork steak'), raw. COLLISION FLAG: labels reading 'pork shoulder steak' can hit the existing pork-shoulder matcher; that entry should exclude 'steak'. Must NOT match pork chops (existing), ham steak, or whole shoulder roasts.

name: Pork Belly
notes: Fresh uncured pork belly, slab or sliced. Must NOT match bacon (existing item, cured/smoked), cured pork belly bites/burnt ends (pre-cooked), salt pork, or ramen kits mentioning pork belly.

name: Spiral / Half Ham (Bone-In)
notes: Whole/half bone-in smoked ham, spiral-cut or shank/butt portion. Existing deli-ham matcher deliberately excludes 'spiral/whole/bone-in', so this slot is open. Must NOT match deli sliced ham (existing), ham steak (separate candidate), canned ham, or ham glaze packets.

name: Ham Steak
notes: Packaged cured ham steak/slice (fixed weight, often bone-in center slice). Existing deli-ham matcher excludes 'steak', so open. Must NOT match deli sliced ham, spiral ham, diced ham cups, or pork steak.

name: Smoked Ham Hocks
notes: Smoked pork hocks/shanks for beans and greens. Existing deli-ham matcher excludes 'hock', so open. Must NOT match fresh pork hocks mislabeled as roasts, dog bones, ham base/bouillon, or canned beans with ham.

name: Pork Neck Bones
notes: Raw or smoked pork neck bones (budget staple at Baker's/Family Fare). Must NOT match beef soup bones (separate candidate), turkey necks, dog bones, or broth.

name: Refrigerated Pulled Pork (Tub)
notes: Ready-to-heat refrigerated pulled pork in BBQ sauce (Lloyd's/Jack Daniel's/store brand). Existing pork-shoulder matcher excludes 'pulled', so open. Must NOT match raw pork shoulder, pulled chicken/beef tubs, canned pork, or frozen pulled-pork meals/sandwiches.

name: Canadian Bacon
notes: Sliced Canadian-style back bacon rounds. Existing bacon matcher excludes 'canadian', so open. Must NOT match regular bacon, turkey bacon (existing), deli ham, pizza topping kits, or frozen breakfast sandwiches.

name: Chicken Tenderloins (Fresh)
notes: Raw/uncooked chicken breast tenderloins. Existing chicken-breast matcher excludes 'tender', so open. Must NOT match breaded tenders/strips (fresh or frozen), cooked popcorn chicken, chicken fries, or canned chicken.

name: Ground Chicken
notes: Raw ground chicken (tray or chub). Must NOT match ground turkey (existing), ground beef, chicken burger patties, canned chicken, or chicken sausage.

name: Bone-In Split Chicken Breast
notes: Raw bone-in, skin-on split chicken breasts (much cheaper per lb than boneless). Existing chicken-breast matcher excludes 'bone-in' and 'split', so open. Must NOT match boneless skinless breast (existing), thighs/drumsticks (existing), or whole chicken.

name: Chicken Sausage
notes: Fully-cooked or fresh chicken sausage links (apple, spinach-feta, etc.). Existing kielbasa and breakfast-sausage matchers exclude 'chicken', so open. Must NOT match pork/turkey sausage, corn dogs, or frozen breakfast links labeled pork.

name: Chicken Livers
notes: Raw chicken livers (tub/tray, fresh or frozen). Must NOT match beef liver (separate candidate), liverwurst, pate, gizzards (separate candidate), or liver-flavor cat/dog food.

name: Chicken Gizzards
notes: Raw chicken gizzards (and gizzard/heart mixes). Must NOT match chicken livers (separate candidate), fried gizzard deli items, or pet treats.

name: Cornish Hens
notes: Frozen whole Cornish game hens. Must NOT match whole chicken (existing item), rotisserie chicken, or chicken parts. If sold per lb, normalize to per-hen using stated weight.

name: Deli Fried Chicken (8-Piece)
notes: Hot deli case fried chicken, 8-piece dark/mixed box (Walmart/Hy-Vee/Baker's/Family Fare deli). Must NOT match rotisserie chicken (existing item), frozen fried chicken bags, chicken tenders by-the-pound, or restaurant items.

name: Whole Turkey (Frozen)
notes: Whole frozen turkey (Butterball/Honeysuckle/store brand). Must NOT match turkey breast roast (separate candidate), ground turkey/turkey bacon/deli turkey (existing items), or cooked holiday meal bundles.

name: Turkey Breast Roast (Bone-In/Netted)
notes: Raw bone-in turkey breast or boneless netted turkey breast roast (incl. Butterball roast in bag). Must NOT match deli sliced turkey (existing turkey-lunchmeat), smoked turkey deli chubs, ground turkey, or lunchmeat tubs.

name: Turkey Sausage
notes: Turkey breakfast sausage roll, links, or smoked turkey sausage rope. Existing breakfast-sausage and kielbasa matchers exclude 'turkey', so open. COLLISION FLAG: 'Italian turkey sausage' labels hit the existing italian-sausage matcher; keep those out. Must NOT match pork sausage or turkey franks.

name: Smoked Turkey Legs / Parts
notes: Smoked turkey drumsticks, wings, or necks (for greens/beans). Must NOT match fresh turkey parts, chicken drumsticks (existing chicken-thighs item), deli turkey, or turkey jerky.

name: Ground Lamb
notes: Raw ground lamb (Aldi/Walmart/Hy-Vee stock year-round). Must NOT match ground beef/turkey/pork (existing), lamb & rice dog food, or gyro meat cones (prepared).

name: Lamb Loin Chops
notes: Raw lamb loin or shoulder chops. Must NOT match pork chops (existing), lamb-flavor pet food, frozen lamb entrees, or leg of lamb roasts.

name: Catfish Fillets
notes: Raw catfish fillets or nuggets, fresh or plain frozen. Must NOT match breaded/battered catfish, cornmeal-coated kits, fish sticks (existing), or cat food.

name: Pollock Fillets (Frozen)
notes: Plain frozen wild Alaska pollock fillets. Must NOT match breaded/battered fillets, fish sticks (existing), imitation crab (made from pollock, separate candidate), or fish sandwich patties.

name: Swai Fillets (Frozen)
notes: Plain frozen swai/basa fillets (budget white fish at Walmart/Family Fare). Must NOT match breaded fish, tilapia or cod (existing items), or seasoned/marinated fillets.

name: Haddock Fillets (Frozen)
notes: Plain frozen wild haddock fillets. Must NOT match beer-battered/breaded haddock, cod (existing item), or frozen fish dinners.

name: Steelhead Trout Fillets
notes: Fresh or frozen steelhead/rainbow trout fillets (Aldi/Hy-Vee regulars). Must NOT match salmon (existing item, similar look), smoked trout, or canned fish.

name: Mahi Mahi Fillets (Frozen)
notes: Plain frozen mahi mahi portions. Must NOT match breaded fish, fish tacos kits, tilapia/cod (existing), or seasoned skillet meals.

name: Ahi Tuna Steaks (Frozen)
notes: Frozen yellowfin/ahi tuna steaks. Existing canned-tuna matcher excludes 'steak/fresh/ahi', so open. Must NOT match canned/pouched tuna (existing), tuna salad kits, sushi trays, or cat food.

name: Snow Crab Legs
notes: Frozen/thawed snow or king crab leg clusters. Must NOT match imitation crab (separate candidate), canned crab (separate candidate), crab cakes, crab dip, or crab boil seasoning.

name: Lobster Tails
notes: Frozen raw lobster tails (Aldi/Hy-Vee/Sam's). Priced each; normalize per-lb listings using stated tail weight. Must NOT match lobster dip, lobster mac frozen meals, langostino, or imitation lobster.

name: Sea Scallops (Frozen)
notes: Frozen raw sea or bay scallops, plain. Must NOT match breaded scallops, bacon-wrapped appetizers, imitation scallops, or scampi meal kits.

name: Imitation Crab (Surimi)
notes: Refrigerated surimi imitation crab flakes/sticks/chunks. Must NOT match real crab legs or canned crab (separate candidates), seafood salad tubs, or sushi rolls.

name: Smoked Salmon (Cold-Smoked/Lox)
notes: Refrigerated cold-smoked salmon/lox slices (Aldi/Hy-Vee/Sam's). Existing salmon matcher excludes 'smoked', so open. Must NOT match fresh salmon fillets (existing), canned salmon (existing), salmon dip/spread, or salmon jerky.

name: Pickled Herring
notes: Refrigerated jarred pickled herring in wine sauce or sour cream (Midwest dairy-case staple). Must NOT match sardines (separate candidate), kipper snacks, anchovies, or pickled vegetables.

name: Canned Sardines
notes: Tinned sardines in oil/water/mustard. Must NOT match canned tuna/salmon (existing), anchovies, kipper herring snacks (close cousin, allow only if labeled sardines), or cat food tins.

name: Canned Mackerel
notes: Canned jack mackerel (budget protein at Walmart/Baker's). Must NOT match canned tuna/salmon/sardines (covered elsewhere), fresh mackerel, or cat food.

name: Canned Clams
notes: Canned chopped/minced/whole baby clams and clam juice combos. Must NOT match clam chowder soup (existing tomato/chicken soups pattern; chowder is a soup), clam strips (frozen breaded), or clam dip.

name: Canned / Smoked Oysters
notes: Tinned smoked or whole oysters. Must NOT match oyster crackers (existing crackers space), oyster sauce, fresh shucked oyster tubs, or oyster stew.

name: Canned Crab Meat
notes: Shelf-stable canned lump/white crab meat. Must NOT match imitation crab (separate candidate), refrigerated pasteurized crab tubs (allow if present), crab legs, crab cakes, or crab dip.

name: Roast Beef (Deli / Sliced)
notes: Deli-counter or prepackaged sliced roast beef lunchmeat. Must NOT match raw beef roasts (rump/chuck), canned roast beef, roast beef frozen meals, or beef jerky.

name: Chicken Breast (Deli / Sliced)
notes: Deli-counter or prepackaged oven-roasted/grilled chicken breast lunchmeat. Must NOT match raw chicken breast (existing), canned chicken (existing), chicken salad (separate candidate), or turkey lunchmeat (existing).

name: Pastrami (Deli / Sliced)
notes: Sliced beef pastrami (prepackaged or deli counter); include deli corned beef slices if labeled together. Must NOT match raw corned beef brisket (separate candidate), pastrami-seasoned salmon, or frozen sandwiches.

name: Bologna
notes: Sliced bologna (regular/beef/thick-cut, Oscar Mayer/Bar-S/store brand). Must NOT match ring bologna (smoked sausage ring), braunschweiger (separate candidate), hot dogs (existing), or Lunchables-type kits.

name: Salami (Sliced)
notes: Sliced hard/Genoa/cotto salami for sandwiches or snacking. Must NOT match pepperoni (existing item), summer sausage (separate candidate), salami whole chubs in gift sets, or charcuterie sampler trays.

name: Braunschweiger / Liverwurst
notes: Braunschweiger or liver sausage chub/sliced (Midwest staple). Must NOT match beef or chicken liver raw (separate candidates), pate, or liver-flavor pet products.

name: Summer Sausage
notes: Beef/original summer sausage chub (Old Wisconsin/Hillshire/store brand). Must NOT match snack sticks (separate candidate), pepperoni, holiday gift sets, or jerky.

name: Prosciutto (Sliced)
notes: Prepackaged sliced prosciutto (Aldi/Hy-Vee carry). Must NOT match deli ham (existing), pancetta, serrano ham, or charcuterie trays with cheese.

name: Cocktail Sausages (Lit'l Smokies)
notes: Miniature smoked cocktail sausages/wieners (Hillshire Lit'l Smokies type). Existing kielbasa matcher excludes 'cocktail', so open. COLLISION FLAG: 'cocktail franks/wieners' labels can hit the existing hot-dogs matcher (includes bare 'franks/wieners'); that entry should exclude 'cocktail/lit'l/little smokies'. Must NOT match full-size hot dogs or pigs-in-blanket frozen appetizers.

name: Chorizo (Fresh Mexican)
notes: Fresh Mexican pork or beef chorizo tube (Cacique/store brand; big seller in Omaha). Must NOT match Spanish cured chorizo links, soy chorizo (allow only meat), breakfast sausage (existing), or chorizo-flavored frozen meals.

name: Chicken Salad (Deli Tub)
notes: Refrigerated deli chicken salad tub (store deli or Resers/Willow Tree type). Must NOT match canned chicken (existing), chicken salad kits with crackers (allow only if the tub is the product), tuna/ham salad, or salad greens.

name: Vienna Sausages (Canned)
notes: Canned Vienna sausages (Libby's/Armour). Must NOT match cocktail smokies (refrigerated, separate candidate), hot dogs, potted meat (separate candidate), or Vienna bread/pastry.

name: Canned Luncheon Meat (Spam)
notes: Canned pork luncheon meat (Spam/Treet/store brand). Must NOT match canned corned beef (separate candidate), potted meat (separate candidate), deli lunchmeat, or Spam-flavored snacks.

name: Potted Meat (Canned)
notes: Small-can potted meat spread (Armour/Libby's budget shelf item). Must NOT match Vienna sausages or Spam (separate candidates), deviled ham (close cousin, allow if labeled potted meat only), or pet food.

name: Canned Corned Beef
notes: Shelf-stable canned corned beef (Libby's/Hormel). Must NOT match raw corned beef brisket (separate candidate), corned beef HASH (potato blend, different product), or deli corned beef slices.

name: Meat Snack Sticks
notes: Cured meat snack sticks (Slim Jim/Old Wisconsin/Jack Link's sticks). Existing beef-jerky matcher excludes 'sticks', so open. Must NOT match beef jerky (existing), string cheese combo packs, pepperoni slices, or dog treat sticks.
